note: Marshall County WV (54051) publishes no queryable zoning district layer that I could find. Moundsville, the largest city, zones via an adopted Official Zoning Map shown only as an image on its city zoning page; its code (1331.07) refers to that map. The county assessor's GIS portal (AGD ArcGIS web app viewer) could not be read for a zoning layer. Glen Dale, McMechen and Benwood have no published zoning GIS. The ZONING layer at gis.districtiii.org MARSHALL_COUNTY_WEB_LAYERS is a different Marshall County (extent in Minnesota/South Dakota area), so it was rejected.
